_comment: Executable version of Allternit's A:// tier mapping (Allternit-platform-future-development / workspace strategy docs' ALLTERNIT_MODEL_TIER_COMPETITOR_MAPPING.md). Only fires for (a) subagents explicitly spawned via the Agent tool on Allternit's behalf, and (b) Phase 6 autonomous agents at spawn time — a running interactive Claude Code session stays on whatever model the user picked; a skill/prompt cannot switch it mid-session.

A://H.role: Fast edge, simple tasks, retrieval, summaries, classification

A://C.role: Everyday reasoning, coding, workflows, routine client execution

A://Fe.role: Deep reasoning, system design, judgment calls, novel/high-stakes scoping
A://Fe.note: Mapped to Fable 5 (the current most-capable generally-available Claude model) rather than Opus 4.8, per this session's system context describing Fable 5 as superseding Opus in the current lineup. Re-check this pairing if the model lineup changes.

A://Boson.note: Same backend as A://Fe for now — Allternit's strategy docs describe Boson as a distinct creative/long-context class, but there is no separate concrete model to route to yet.

A://Hadron.note: NOT YET BACKED. No dedicated safety/guardrail model or classifier exists in this stack today. Do not route real guardrail decisions here until this is filled in — flag rather than silently falling back to a general-purpose model for a safety-critical check.

classification.example: tag an inbound lead, sort a support message

client_coding_work.example: routine Tier A/B catalog deliverable, standard workflow build

quote_routine.example: quote a request that matches a known catalog line or bundle directly

architecture_or_novel_judgment.example: system design, a Tier C audit's scoping judgment, a pricing edge case with no catalog match

quote_tier_c_scoping.example: deciding what the paid discovery phase should cover before any number is given

creative_or_long_form.example: brand narrative, long-form content, Register 2 voice work

cad_design.example: mechanical CAD modeling, PCB layout, assembly design — requires spatial reasoning and multi-constraint problem solving

cad_simulation.example: CFD thermal analysis, FEM structural validation, MuJoCo joint/sensor config — physics reasoning

cad_render.example: Blender product render, material application, lighting/camera setup — routine visual work

cad_export.example: STEP/STL/Gerber/G-code export, DRC/ERC checks — deterministic validation

cad_quoting.example: JLCPCB component pricing, BOM lookup, print-time estimation — retrieval + arithmetic

guardrail_check.example: NOT YET BACKED — see A://Hadron note; do not silently downgrade this to another tier
